title: Countach vs Miura: The Real Difference
description:
Two Lamborghinis, from the same factory, by the same stylist, five years apart. One is a rounded, curvy car that hid its engine at its own launch. The other is a wedge that people put on their bedroom walls. They look nothing alike, and they sit on opposite sides of a design revolution. This is the real difference between the Lamborghini Countach and the Lamborghini Miura. Here is the twist. The Countach is the car everyone remembers, but on the figures we found, it was not dramatically heavier or lighter, faster or slower than the Miura at the top of its range. The big differences are in layout, in numbers built, and in what the cars sell for today. Let us go through them, and say where the sources disagree.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
